## Bio

Nicolas Robinson-Garcia is associate professor in the field of bibliometrics and research evaluation at the University of Granada. He is interested in understanding how collaboration and social organization shape the way science works and the diversity of career paths scientists follow. He is scientific director of the [Unit for Computational Humanities and Social Sciences (U\^CHASS)](https://uchass.ugr.es) and member of the [EC3 Research Group](https://ec3investigacion.ugr.es). He is co-editor of the journal [Research Evaluation](https://academic.oup.com/rev/) and member of the editorial board of [Quantitative Science Studies](https://direct.mit.edu/qss).
